notes: This contract records a portable IEEE 1516.1 test of the sender time-regulating role in timestamped attribute-update order classification. Keep the attribute's timestamp-order preference and supplied logical timestamp fixed: before regulation, the update is received in receive order and supplies no valid retraction handle; after regulation, the update is timestamp order, remains queued until receiver advancement, and supplies a valid retraction handle. The C++ scenario also checks that Time Regulation Enabled reports the assigned initial time, Query Logical Time agrees, and Query Lookahead returns the requested lookahead in this no-competing-regulator setup; it does not cover minimum-time selection under additional constraints. The adapter supplies the provider, standard FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. This focused API check is not conformance evidence.
